title: Adventure Path
description: A fantasy & adventure themed Modpack with systems inspired by TTRPGS
body:
![Adventure Path, a Modpack inspired by the Pathfinder TTRPG](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/629fe1e457052a2002434afdfbd18b6345dd15dc.jpeg)
![Collect Sticks and Stones to start your Adventure](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/373f47563bd1fa1285a17497409fac59695b3803_0.webp)
![Build Campfires to heal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9fa59ef7b12530e281a778afcf2906a6c4ca1f70_0.webp)
![Levels and Difficulty](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/42f8d8f62c84eae95f6368c0487b0c3d091a3c6a_0.webp)

## Core Features:
- Pathfinder inspired origins
- Pathfinder inspired levels
- No health regen (use campfires to heal)
- Multiplayer enhancements like reviving, voice chat and speech bubbles
- Magic by iron's spellbooks
- Vampirism & Werewolves
- Configured Tectonic for extra height and depth
- Create + popular addons
